results.title: Man Leaves Fiancée Days Before Wedding With A One-Way Ticket And Barely Any Explanation
results.description: Four days before she was meant to get married, one woman’s life was turned upside down by a confession she never saw coming. She thought she and her fiancé were happily in love, but he suddenly told her his feelings had changed and revealed he was leaving for Asia to “find himself.” Then he simply walked out. With the ceremony just around the corner, she was left heartbroken, confused, and forced to deal with the fallout of a future she thought was already certain.

results.title: Batwara 1947 FIRST Review: Sunny Deol-Preity Zinta Starrer Is 'A Beautifully Made Film With A Powerful Message'
results.description: Ramesh Taurani praised director Rajkumar Santoshi after watching Batwara 1947, which releases on August 14. The producer said Santoshi had once again told a story that "strikes an emotional chord" with audiences. Calling the film beautifully made with a powerful message, Taurani also congratulated Aparna Purohit and Aamir Khan Productions for producing the film.
